lanes.description: A tank strike combines immediate Physical damage with a long, stacking Shadow damage-over-time effect.
lanes.name: Bloodvenom Injection

lanes.description: A heavy tank hit increases the golem's Physical damage when repeated on the same target. Striking a different target ends that escalation.
lanes.name: Empowering Slam

lanes.description: A venom debuff periodically damages selected players. Contact between two contaminated players neutralizes it; touching an unaffected player instead causes an eruption.
lanes.name: Shifting Protovenom

lanes.description: Drops toxic objects that explode if left alone. Players can step on them to destroy them early, taking Nature damage.
lanes.name: Toxic Droplets

lanes.description: A marked player detonates after a delay. Nearby players share the Shadow damage and receive applications of Clinging Murk.
lanes.name: Unstable Miasma

lanes.description: Creates a mass of venom that becomes a living slime add.
lanes.name: Venom Coagulation

lanes.description: Compresses numerous healing casts into a short burst.

effectiveness.note: Healer and owned-pet output during this window, including other spells and existing HoTs/shields. This is not healing attributed solely to the cooldown. Damage prevention and health redistribution are not measured.

modifiers: Cenarius’ Guidance: Halves the cooldown and reduces channel duration and spell count by 25%; also improves the chance of an exceptional spell.

Control of the Dream: Keeper of the Grove: time spent ready before activation is subtracted from the next cooldown, capped at 15 seconds. Choice with Power of the Dream. This is variable recovery, not a permanent cooldown reduction.
lanes.name: Convoke the Spirits
notes: Tree of Life and Convoke are alternatives.
Control of the Dream may subtract up to a further 15 seconds on a given use; that reduction requires prior ready time.

lanes.description: A sustained raid-healing channel.
modifiers: Flourish: Tranquility extends your existing heal-over-time effects by 2 seconds every second of the channel. Flourish is a passive modifier here, not a separate scheduled cooldown.
Regenesis: Increases Tranquility healing, with a larger benefit on low-health targets. Two-rank talent; does not alter its cooldown or channel length.
lanes.name: Tranquility
notes: Use the full, uninterrupted channel as the nominal window; haste and interruptions can change realized channel time.
Inner Peace has a -30-second tooltip and appears in legacy modifier data, but is absent from the retrieved current talent tree. Do not assume a 150-second cooldown without checking the character.

lanes.description: A large initial heal and a sustained window of stronger core healing spells.
modifiers: First Ascendant: Reduces Ascendance or Healing Tide Totem cooldown by 60 seconds. Choice with Preeminence.
Preeminence: Alternative to First Ascendant: adds 3 seconds to Ascendance/Healing Tide Totem and grants haste while active.
Oversurge: Totemic: increases Surging Totem output while Ascendance or Healing Tide Totem is active. The generic tooltip mixes specialization effects; no numeric healing coefficient is asserted here.
Deeply Rooted Elements: Riptide can trigger a separate 6-second Ascendance proc. This does not reduce the manual ability’s cooldown and is not independently schedulable.
lanes.name: Ascendance
notes: Ascendance and Healing Tide Totem are alternatives in the current tree.
First Ascendant and Preeminence are also alternatives; a 120-second cooldown plus 18-second base duration is not a valid combination of those talents.

lanes.description: Major group stabilization through redistribution and mitigation; adds direct burst healing with Spouting Spirits.
modifiers: Spouting Spirits: Adds a substantial heal 1 second after placement and increases the totem’s damage reduction.
Lively Totems: Totemic: placing Spirit Link Totem also casts a free Chain Heal.
lanes.name: Spirit Link Totem
notes: Redistribution alone does not create net group healing. This is included as a healing/defensive hybrid because its current talents add major direct healing.
The 1-second delayed burst is not the totem’s duration; the totem lasts 6 seconds.

lanes.description: A high-output Holy Word window with greatly improved access to Holy Words.

effectiveness.note: Healer and owned-pet output during this window, including other spells and existing HoTs/shields. This is not healing attributed solely to the cooldown. Damage prevention and health redistribution are not measured.

modifiers: Eternal Sanctity: Adds 12 seconds, giving a 32-second base window. Choice with Divinity.
Divinity: Alternative to Eternal Sanctity: adds healing during Apotheosis and empowers the next three Prayers of Healing.
Perfected Form: Archon: increases healing during Apotheosis.

Sustained Potency: Archon: each created Halo extends Apotheosis by 1 second; up to 6 seconds can be stored while it is inactive. Also pauses its duration during certain downtime, up to 20 seconds. Choice with Energy Compression.
lanes.name: Apotheosis
notes: Sustained Potency makes the total window variable. Do not assume 20 or 32 seconds is always the final observed length.
Older Answered Prayers/Divine Word advice was not used as evidence of current additional cooldowns.

lanes.description: A raid-healing channel that also increases subsequent healing received.
modifiers: Seraphic Crescendo: Reduces Divine Hymn’s cooldown by 60 seconds. Choice with Gales of Song.
Gales of Song: Alternative to Seraphic Crescendo: distributes Prayer of Mending stacks each second during the channel.
Benediction: The relevant Apex effect adds a Cosmic Ripple to each Divine Hymn pulse.
lanes.name: Divine Hymn
notes: Each pulse applies/refreshes a 15-second stacking healing-received buff. That trailing buff is separate from the 5-second channel.
The current channel is 5 seconds, not the 8 seconds retained by some trackers.

lanes.description: Group recovery scaled to damage recently taken.
modifiers: Temporal Artificer: Reduces Rewind’s cooldown by 60 seconds.

Time Convergence: Chronowarden: eligible non-defensive abilities with a cooldown of at least 45 seconds grant a 15-second Intellect buff; Essence spells extend it by 1 second. This is a secondary throughput buff, not the duration of the healing spell.
lanes.name: Rewind
notes: The damage look-back is 5 seconds; the healing-over-time effect is 4 seconds. These are different windows.
Chronowarden Temporal Burst can accelerate cooldown recovery dynamically; do not hard-code its recovery as a flat reduction.

lanes.description: Stores and replays three healing spells for a large prepared burst.

effectiveness.note: Stasis is storing spells. Select its Release to review healing output.

Healer and owned-pet output during this window, including other spells and existing HoTs/shields. This is not healing attributed solely to the cooldown. Damage prevention and health redistribution are not measured.

modifiers: Inner Flame: Activating Dream Flight or Stasis adds a substantial healing-over-time bonus and increases Essence Burst generation from Living Flame/Reversion. The buff lasts 20 seconds for Dream Flight or 15 seconds for Stasis.

Time Convergence: Chronowarden: eligible non-defensive abilities with a cooldown of at least 45 seconds grant a 15-second Intellect buff; Essence spells extend it by 1 second. This is a secondary throughput buff, not the duration of the healing spell.
lanes.name: Stasis
notes: Dream Flight and Stasis are mutually exclusive.
Stores three helpful spells; after the sequence is loaded, the release window is 30 seconds. Healing duration depends on the spells stored.
Spell data marks cooldown start after the aura fades; cooldown planners should confirm the observed release/end event rather than starting a timer from the first preparation press.

lanes.description: Included as a major throughput window specifically when Chronowarden’s Temporal Burst is selected.

effectiveness.note: Healer and owned-pet output during this window, including other spells and existing HoTs/shields. This is not healing attributed solely to the cooldown. Damage prevention and health redistribution are not measured.

modifiers: Temporal Burst: Chronowarden: Tip the Scales grants a 30-second window of decaying haste, movement speed and cooldown recovery, starting at 30%.
Chronoboon: Chronowarden: reduces Tip the Scales’ cooldown by 30 seconds.

Time Convergence: Chronowarden: eligible non-defensive abilities with a cooldown of at least 45 seconds grant a 15-second Intellect buff; Essence spells extend it by 1 second. This is a secondary throughput buff, not the duration of the healing spell.
lanes.name: Tip the Scales — Temporal Burst build
notes: Without Temporal Burst, Tip the Scales is principally an instant maximum-rank empower enabler and falls below this report’s major-throughput scope.
The base effect is consumed by the next empowered spell; it is not itself a fixed 30-second healing buff.
Temporal Burst’s changing recovery rate prevents a universal effective cooldown for the Evoker kit.

footnotes: Solid windows show nominal catalogue durations unless a matching self buff provides an observed duration. Channels can end early or scale with haste.
Dashed recovery and ready markers are estimates from base values and recorded talents. Dynamic recovery, resets and unrecorded talents can change availability.
Stasis distinguishes preparation (Store) from the recorded Release. Recovery is estimated from release; without a recorded release no ready marker is inferred.
Raid pressure = health damage excluding overkill + healing absorbed when consumed, per second in 2-second bins. It does not measure outstanding heal-absorb shields or damage prevented by mitigation.
Catalogue: supplied Midnight 12.1 research, 24 cooldowns and 68 tracked abilities. Boss markers are recorded casts; catalogue display durations are not treated as verified effect durations.
